title: INT8 model misses faults on the gateway
scenario: A day after Corvane switched its pump gateways to the INT8 model, a vibration route finds an outer-race fault that the edge system never alerted on; no pump raised a single alert all day. The release log warns about IR versions and pre-processing and the gateway says XNNPACK is missing. Is INT8 just not accurate enough?
task: Find the root cause with numbers from the INT8 graph and the data
Rule the release and runtime warnings in or out
Fix the release script so INT8 detects like FP32
Propose the release gate that would have stopped it
acceptance: INT8 within 0.02 recall and 0.01 false-alarm rate of FP32 on the gateway day
INT8 input range fits the standardized features from the shipped scaler.json
Still static INT8 QDQ and under 0.6x FP32 size
ANSWER.md: root cause with inspect evidence, red herrings, prevention
